changelog:
Initial release of the Generate Personal Brand Ad Creative Brief skill.

- Enables structured planning of campaign visuals and messaging hooks for personal brand paid promotions.
- Designed for use by thought leaders, coaches, and personal brand builders.
- Workflow guides users from audience/goals definition to first draft and refinement.
- Integrates with chat and image generation APIs to create and enrich campaign briefs.
- Optimized for automation and search phrases like "ad creative brief AI" and "personal brand ad planning".
